'''Statman''' published constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]]. In September 2003 he wrote on the [[Players Committee]] forum that he had just run his area's first Star Wars CCG event in nearly two years, with seven players, and that he had eight [[Classic]] decks built to lend to new players.<ref name="pcf-1063-33102">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33102#33102 Classic / Non-Classic], Statman, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040918135527/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=20831%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In May 2004 he asked how to get a State Championship scheduled, saying an e-mail he had sent six weeks earlier had gone unanswered;<ref name="pcf-3284-46138">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46138#46138 State Championships], Statman, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625211744/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46748%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Nick Kolnik]] replied, addressing him as Scott, that he should e-mail him.<ref name="pcf-3284-46748">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46748#46748 State Championships], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625211744/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46748%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
